input.value: mock DiscriminatorContext where getDiscriminatorForPath(any) returns null
JsonSchema whose schemaNode does NOT contain a "discriminator" field

cases.expected: No exception thrown; currentDiscriminatorContext.registerDiscriminator called once with schema.schemaLocation and the original discriminator (unchanged)
cases.description: When the schema does not define a discriminator, the method should simply register the supplied discriminator without attempting any merge.

input.value: mock DiscriminatorContext where getDiscriminatorForPath(any) returns a non‑null discriminator ObjectNode

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException thrown with message containing "attempts redefining the discriminator property"
cases.description: When the schema defines a discriminator that already contains a "propertyName" field, the method must reject the redefinition and throw a JsonSchemaException.

input.value: mock DiscriminatorContext where getDiscriminatorForPath(any) returns a discriminator ObjectNode that already has a "mapping" field

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException thrown with message containing "discriminator mapping redefinition from A" and the two different mapping values
cases.description: When both the root discriminator and the nested schema provide a mapping for the same key but with different values, the method must detect the conflict and throw a JsonSchemaException.

ObjectNode where "mapping" field is a TextNode (e.g., "notAnObject")

cases.description: If the existing root discriminator's "mapping" field is not an ObjectNode, the cast to ObjectNode fails, resulting in a ClassCastException.

JsonSchema whose schemaNode contains {"discriminator": {"mapping": "notAnObject"}} (mapping is a TextNode)
